tools.name: create_customer_account
tools.title: Create Customer Account
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Set up a whole oriiion account for a customer and start their onboarding: it reads their website (or Instagram profile if they have no site), sets the brand, picks images, adds news sources and products, writes a style guide and drafts their first posts. Takes a few minutes and costs roughly $0.30 of generation per account. NOTHING is sent to the customer by this tool — check progress with get_customer_onboarding, then use send_customer_welcome once it looks right.

email.description: The customer's email address — this becomes their login

websiteUrl.description: The customer's website. A bare domain like taximalmo.se is fine.

instagramUrl.description: The customer's Instagram profile, used only when they have no website. A handle like @taximalmo is fine.

businessName.description: Business name, if known. The onboarding fills this in from the site otherwise.

interfaceLanguage.description: Two-letter language for the customer's interface and emails. Defaults to sv.

accountType.description: small_business for a company, thought_leader for a person building a personal brand

tools.name: create_customer_account_manual
tools.title: Create Customer Account Manually
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Create a ready-to-use account from a supplied name, bio and category, without a website or Instagram. Skips onboarding and grants complimentary premium access for 12 months by default (or until compUntil), plus expiring inbox, website and Business Suite access. Website and suite grants can be switched off. No scraping, research, Stripe calls, email, SMS or password links. send_customer_welcome stays a separate human-requested step.

email.description: The customer's login email. Trimmed and lowercased.

bio.description: The supplied business or personal bio; stored as businessAbout.

compUntil.description: Future ISO date or datetime. Defaults to creation time plus 12 calendar months.

websiteUrl.description: Stored on the profile only. Never fetched or researched.

instagramUrl.description: Stored in provisioning metadata only. Never fetched.

tools.name: get_customer_onboarding
tools.title: Get Customer Onboarding Status
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Where a customer's onboarding has got to and what it has done so far, including anything that went wrong and whether they have been sent their login yet. Look at this before send_customer_welcome — the research step can misread a site, and it is cheaper to notice here than after the customer has.

tools.name: send_customer_welcome
tools.title: Send Customer Welcome
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Tell the customer their account exists and give them a way in. ALWAYS ASK which channel they should be contacted on — there is no default, and if the answer is SMS you must also ask for their phone number, which the tool will refuse to proceed without. Sends a link to choose their own password, valid for 7 days; a password is never put in a message. Sends once per customer — pass resend to issue a new link, which stops the old one working.

email.description: The customer's email address — the account to send for

notifyVia.description: REQUIRED. Ask the person you are helping which channel the customer should be contacted on. Do not guess.

phoneNumber.description: REQUIRED when notifyVia is sms. The customer's mobile number, e.g. 070 123 45 67 or +46701234567.

resend.description: Send again to a customer who already got their login. Issues a new link and invalidates the previous one — only use it when someone asked.

tools.name: send_password_reset
tools.title: Send Password Reset Link
tools.description: Email a password reset link to the address on an oriiion account. STAFF can name any customer by email; everyone else can only reset their own account. The link is only mailed, never shown, and replaces any earlier link. Use when someone cannot sign in or asks to change their password.

email.description: The account's email address. Required for staff; leave out to reset your own account.

tools.name: get_agent_onboarding
tools.title: Get Agent Onboarding
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Everything about one agent onboarding in a single read: the customer's progress on the page (email confirmed, sign-in, payment, connected channels, questionnaire answers), the build's progress and log, the brand on the account, the cards you have sent and how the customer answered, and what the customer did since your last read (newFromCustomer). Pass back the returned cursor as since; pass waitSeconds to wait for the customer instead of polling.

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

since.description: The cursor from the previous read. Only customer actions after it are listed under newFromCustomer.

waitSeconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds (max 25) for the customer to do something new after "since" before answering.

tools.name: send_agent_onboarding_card
tools.title: Send Agent Onboarding Card
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Show the customer something on their onboarding page: kind website asks them to confirm their site (title and share image fetched by the server; confirming it starts the build), kind brand asks them to approve the logo, colours and fonts currently on their account — both pop up for the customer, who can also leave them for later. Kind note is a message in the chat beside the onboarding (also how you answer the customer's chat messages). A new website or brand card replaces an unanswered one.

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

kind.description: website: ask the customer to confirm their site (the server fetches its title and share image). brand: ask them to approve the logo, colours and fonts as they stand on the account now. note: a short message, nothing to answer.

websiteUrl.description: For kind "website": the site to show. Defaults to the one the customer typed.

message.description: A short line in the customer's language, shown on the card. Required for kind "note".

tools.name: start_agent_onboarding_build
tools.title: Start Agent Onboarding Build
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Start building the customer's account (research, brand, images, sources, products, style guide, first posts — a few minutes, about $0.30) on a website, without waiting for the customer to confirm it. The build starts by itself when they confirm the website card, and on the typed address ten minutes after signup; use this when you have good reason not to wait. Runs once per onboarding.

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

websiteUrl.description: The site to build from. Defaults to the one the customer typed or last corrected.

tools.name: set_agent_onboarding_brand
tools.title: Set Agent Onboarding Brand
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Change the logo, brand colours or fonts on the customer's account (not yours), e.g. after they asked for a change on the brand card. colors.background is the ground the posts are drawn on, colors.text the words on it — the brand card shows exactly that. Black, white or grey is the brand when the website's own background is that colour or the customer says so: keep it. Then send a new brand card so they can approve the result.

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

logoUrl.description: A public https URL of the logo image. It is copied to our storage.

background.description: The ground the posts are drawn on: the brand's main colour (an all-black shop: its black).

text.description: The colour of the words written on that ground.

tools.name: set_agent_onboarding_images
tools.title: Set Agent Onboarding Images
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Turn AI-generated pictures off (or on) for the customer's account (not yours) — when the customer says they do not want AI images, use false and say so in a note. With false, every post is made from their own photos (website, products, listings) and nothing draws a picture for them.

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

useAiImages.description: false: only the customer's own photos, never an AI-generated picture. true: their photos mixed with AI images.

tools.name: finish_agent_onboarding
tools.title: Finish Agent Onboarding
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Mark your work on the onboarding as done and give the customer your closing message, in their language. The page shows it with a button to their dashboard. Pass staffSummary for support. Call once, when the build is done and the website and brand are settled (or the customer stopped answering — what they did not answer stays on their page as a to-do).

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

message.description: Your closing message to the customer, in their language: what is ready and what (if anything) they still need to do on the page.

staffSummary.description: For oriiion support, in English, 3–5 lines: the business, what the customer confirmed or changed, anything a human must look at. Stored in the support log, never shown to the customer.

tools.name: log_agent_onboarding
tools.title: Log Agent Onboarding Step
tools.description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Write one line in the onboarding's support log: the step you are on and what you did or found, in English. Support reads this log to follow an onboarding; the customer never sees it. Log each step as you go.

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

detail.description: What you did or found, in English, one or two sentences, for oriiion support.
